To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the annual modulation signature in the DAMA/Na I experiment has been observed at the level of 6.3σ CL with an exposure of 10 5 k g × day, collected with a highly radiopure set-up, over 7 annual cycles, with no side reactions able to simulate it.

1) The DAMA/NAI and DAMA/LIBRE experiments have pointed out the existence of a Dark Matter annual modulation signal at 6.2σ C.L. in model-independent way; 2) the DAMA/NAi and DAMA/LIBE experiments, together with the other experiments, have shown the existence of a DM annual modulation signal at the 6.2 σ C.L. in a model-dependent way; 3) the DAMA/LIBE experiment
the DAMA/Na1 experiment has pointed out a positive model independent result at 6.2 sigma C.L., which has been confirmed in a corollary model-dependent analysis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the Dark Matter particle nature by means of the annual modulation signature.
the study of Dark Matter particles in the Universe and their possible interactions with ordinary matter.

the study of the nature of Dark Matter particles, with a particular attention to the model independent approach, and with the development and the realization of new techniques for the detection of rare events.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the experimental situation is still open and that the possibility to detect Dark Matter particles with a model independent approach is still open and will be further investigated by the DAMA/LIBRE experiment (with an exposure ≃ 1000 kg × yr) foreseen to be installed in the Gran Sasso Underground Laboratory of the Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare in Italy.
the Dark Matter particle has been detected in the galactic Halo by the DAMA experiment.
the Dark Matter particle has been detected by the DAMA/NaIs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the experimental results of DAMA/NAI are compatible with the presence of Dark matter particles in the galactic halos and the DAMA/LIBRE experiment is now in a position to test the hypothesis.
the Dark Matter particle has been discovered, the question now is: which one?
the experimental situation in this field is still in its infancy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Dark Matter is a real phenomenon, which is not yet understood.
the DAMA/LIBRE set-up is now in operation.
the annual modulation signal is a robust signature and it can be exploited in a model independent manner.
